evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Call ended abruptly when customer said 'Hey, I have another call and I had to kind of jump on to that.' Amy responded 'Oh, yeah sure. Go ahead. I'll just email you the estimate' with no attempt to close, no rate lock, no ask for business

top_strength: Amy asked the two-concerns question early and cleanly before any logistics probing, and gathered comprehensive inventory and logistics details with a structured walkthrough that included the box count expectation.
coaching_note: The call was interrupted by the customer, but Amy never made it to the estimate itself, never delivered the two promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) that directly answer the concerns the customer named, and never attempted to close or ask for the business — she needs to prioritize getting to the promises immediately after the two-concerns question, before the long probing section.
